exactText: I think that there is a 33% chance that, for average real-world computation, there exist ways to implement all three of what I call the Egyptian God Protocols (SNARK, FHE, iO) with 1+ε factor overhead ... And a 60% chance that all three can be done with single-digit overhead (ie. <10x ...). I think there's a good chance we'll get one of these (probably SNARKs with single-digit overhead) by the end of this decade.
sourceQuote: a 60% chance that all three can be done with single-digit overhead (ie. <10x ...). I think there's a good chance we'll get one of these (probably SNARKs with single-digit overhead) by the end of this decade.
normalizedClaim: There is a 60% chance that SNARKs, FHE, and iO can all operate with <10x overhead, and a good chance at least one (likely SNARKs) reaches single-digit overhead by the end of the 2020s.
resolutionCriteria: Peer-reviewed papers, conference presentations, or production implementations demonstrating SNARKs/FHE/iO with measured overhead <10x (or near 1+ε) for realistic workloads by 2030-12-31.
